paite: Huchi in Solomon athum khit in van a kipan mei ahong kesuk a, halmang thillat leh kithoihnate ahong kangmangta a, huan TOUPA thupina'n inn adimta hi.
heading: Tempul Latna / (1 Kum 8.62-66)

paite: TOUPA thupina in TOUPA' inn adimsak ziak in TOUPA' inn ah siampute alut thei kei uhi.

Israel suante in van a kipan a mei hong lengsuk leh inn tung a TOUPA thupina a-en nilouh ua, suanglep tung ah mai a lei si in abokkhup ua, TOUPA phat in abia uhi. "Amah lah ahoih ngal a, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi," chi in chibai abuk ua, kipahthu agen uhi.
Kumpipa leh mipite'n TOUPA ma ah kithoihnate alan uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon in kithoihna bawngtal singnih-le-sangnih leh belam nuaikhat-le-singnih alan uhi. Huchibang in kumpipa leh mipite'n Pathian inn alan uhi.

Huan siampute amun chiat uah adingh ua; Levite leng TOUPA kiang a kipahthu genna ding a phuah, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi, chi a TOUPA phatna dia David in azat sek, thil ging thei toh TOUPA lasa in adingh ua; huchi in siampute'n pengkul amut ua, Israel mi tengteng adingh diamduam uhi.

Solomon in TOUPA' inn mazawn a um sung kongtual ahihsiangthou behlap a; huai ah halmang thillatte, lemna thillat thaute alan a; Solomon dal maitam bawl halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, thaute latna ding a aneu luat ziak in.
Huchi in huai tung in Solomon leh Israel mi tengteng mipi kikaikhawm thupitak Hamath kholutna a kipan a Aigupta gam lui pha a mite toh ni sagih ankuang alui uhi.
Ani giat ni in kikhopna tak anei ua; maitam kipahpihna ding in ni sagih azang ua, ankuanglui ni a ding in ni sagih azang uhi.

Huchi in akha sagihna ani sawmnih-le-thum ni in mipite akikhensak a, TOUPA'N David leh Solomon leh ami Israelte tung a ahoihna alatsak ziak in nuamsatak leh kipaktak in mite a-inn lam chiat uah apaita uhi.
Huchibang in, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn apichinta a; Solomon in alungsim a atup bang in TOUPA' inn leh ama inn lamzangtak in apichinta hi.
heading: Solomon Kiang A TOUPA Kilak Nawnna / (1 Kum 9.1-9)

paite: Huan zan in Solomon kiang ah TOUPA ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Na thumna ka za a, hiai mun kei a ding in kithoihna inn ding in ka sep khin hi.
Vante ka khak a, vuahte azuk louh in hiam, khaukhup ka sawl a, gamte ahihsiat hiam, ka mite lak a hipi ka lensak hiam a;
ka min pu ka mite kingaineu a athum ua, ahon zon ua, a-omdan giloute uh alehngatsan uleh van a kipan in ka na ngaikhe ding a, akhelhna uh ka ngaidam ding a, agam uh ka damsak ding hi.
Hiai mun a thumna ka mit ka suan ding a, ka bil ka doh ding hi.
Huai a ka min tangtawn a a-omtheihna ding in hiai inn ka sep a, ka hihsingthouta hi: huai ah ka mit leh ka lungtang a-om tawntungta ding hi.
Huan nang tungtang thu ah leng, na pa David bang a ka mitmuh a na om a, thu ka hon piak bang a na om a, ka dan thusehte leh ka vaihawmte na zuihleh:
Israelte lak ah 'vaihawmmi na tasam kei ding,' chi a na pa David kiang a ka thukhun bang in 'na gam laltutphah ka kipsak ding hi.'
Himahleh na kiheimang ua, ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte na lehngatsan ua, Pathian dangte nna na sep ua, na biak uleh:

Amau ka piak gam a kipan ka hon hihmang ding a; hiai inn, ka min ding a ka hihsiangthousa, ka mitmuh phak louh ah ka suanmang ding a, nam chih lak a paunak leh aselam a gentehna ding in ka bawl ding hi.
'Hiai inn sangpi akiang a pai peuh in lamdang asa ding ua, bangchi a hiai gam leh hiai inn TOUPA'N hichi a hih ahia? achi ding uh.'
TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian, 'Aigupta gam a kipan pikhepa alehngatsan ua, Pathian dangte zui a, abiak ua, a-nnate asep ziak un hiai siatna tengteng atung uah atung ahi, ahon chi ding uh achi hi.'
